latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video JSON Prompt.

- Convert images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos using JSON prompts.
- Simple authentication with automatic free token setup for new users.
- Supports batch uploads, timeline editing, text overlays, and audio tracks.
- Cloud-based rendering with typical processing times of 30–90 seconds.
- Intuitive command handling for exporting, credits, status, and uploads.
- Includes clear guidance on file types, error codes, and best practices.
